2607.08395.title: Token-Flow Firewall: Semantic Runtime Auditing for Persistent AI Agents
2607.08395.paper_summary: Persistent AI agents extend large language models (LLMs) beyond single-turn interaction into long-lived software systems. Unlike traditional chat assistants, unsafe content in these agents can propagate through persistent state, reusable skills, and tool-mediated interactions, creating a substantially larger semantic attack surface. We observe that most security-critical interactions in such agents are transmitted through natural-language token flows, including memory updates, tool arguments, retrieved files, and inter-component communications. This observation enables a new security formulation: unsafe behavior can be intercepted as risky semantic flows before reaching privileged runtime sinks. Based on this insight, we propose TokenWall, a runtime defense framework that acts as a semantic firewall over agent token flows. TokenWall performs boundary-aware semantic auditing over these flows, constructing structured source-sink audit records, applying lightweight local inspection before execution, and selectively escalating ambiguous high-risk cases to stronger arbitration modules. Unlike prior approaches that rely on sparse auditing or remote large-model oversight, TokenWall enables full-coverage pre-execution mediation while reducing remote arbitration and latency. Experiments on CIK-Bench show that TokenWall reduces attack success rate to 12.5% while maintaining a 97.4% benign executable pass rate without human confirmation. TokenWall further introduces only 0.69 seconds of additional latency on benign cases, demonstrating that semantic runtime containment can achieve a practical security-utility trade-off for persistent AI agents.
2607.08395.paper_summary_zh: 持久型 AI 代理將大型語言模型 (LLMs) 擴展到超越單輪互動的長期軟體系統。與傳統聊天助手不同，這些代理中的不安全內容可以通過持久狀態、可重用技能和工具介導的互動進行傳播，從而創造出一個實質上更大的語義攻擊面。我們觀察到，在這些代理中，大多數安全關鍵的互動是通過自然語言標記流傳輸的，包括記憶更新、工具參數、檔案檢索和組件間通信。這一觀察使得一種新的安全公式成為可能：不安全行為可以在到達特權運行時匯流之前，作為風險語義流被攔截。基於這一見解，我們提出了 TokenWall，一種運行時防禦框架，作為代理標記流的語義防火牆。TokenWall 對這些流進行邊界感知的語義審計，構建結構化的源-匯審計記錄，在執行前應用輕量級的本地檢查，並選擇性地將模糊的高風險案例上升到更強的仲裁模組。與依賴稀疏審計或遠程大型模型監督的先前方法不同，TokenWall 實現了全覆蓋的執行前調解，同時減少了遠程仲裁和延遲。在 CIK-Bench 上的實驗顯示，TokenWall 將攻擊成功率降低至 12.5%，同時保持 97.4% 的良性可執行通過率，且無需人為確認。TokenWall 進一步僅在良性案例上引入 0.69 秒的額外延遲，證明語義運行時控制可以為持久型 AI 代理實現實用的安全-效用權衡。
